title: Your Raise Disappeared. Here's Why.
hook: Lifestyle creep eats a raise faster than tax does.
question: Did your last raise disappear?

scenes.narration: You got a raise. Six months later, it's gone. And tax isn't the main reason.
It's lifestyle creep. A bigger paycheck quietly becomes a bigger apartment, a nicer car, more subscriptions. Spending rises to meet income.
scenes.sub: spending rises to swallow the raise

scenes.narration: A twenty thousand dollar raise can turn into two thousand saved, once the upgrades settle in.
Did your last raise quietly disappear?
